##### Project general facts

Velora and Venera at The Valley by Emaar Properties introduce a new standard of townhouse living within the master-planned community of The Valley. The development features premium 3- and 4-bedroom townhouses designed to combine modern luxury with a nature-inspired lifestyle, offering residents a peaceful suburban retreat surrounded by lush landscapes and open green spaces.

The architecture focuses on a seamless blend of form and function, where each residence is thoughtfully designed to maximize space, natural light, and comfort. Homes feature spacious layouts, contemporary design elements, and views of the surrounding greenery, creating a refined living environment that balances elegance with everyday practicality. The community setting enhances this experience with a strong sense of privacy and tranquility.

Residents benefit from a wide range of lifestyle amenities that support active and family-oriented living within a well-established community. Surrounded by landscaped parks and open areas, the development encourages outdoor activities and social interaction in a serene environment. The interiors feature modern finishing with high-quality materials and a warm, natural aesthetic. The kitchens are equipped with appliances and designed in a closed layout, while the townhouses are offered unfurnished.

##### Location description and benefits

The Valley is a master-planned residential community, located along Dubai–Al Ain Road. Designed as a self-sustained suburban destination, it offers a peaceful lifestyle surrounded by vast open landscapes, greenery, and thoughtfully planned neighborhoods, creating a calm retreat away from the city’s core while maintaining strong connectivity.

The community is centered around family-oriented living, featuring wide green parks, landscaped gardens, walking trails, sports facilities, and dedicated leisure zones. With retail areas, schools, and everyday conveniences integrated into the master plan, residents benefit from a well-balanced environment that supports both comfort and an active outdoor lifestyle.

Strategically positioned, The Valley provides convenient access to key destinations across Dubai, including Downtown Dubai, Dubai Outlet Mall, and major highways connecting to the rest of the emirate. Its combination of spacious living, natural surroundings, and modern infrastructure makes it one of Dubai’s most appealing suburban residential communities.
